name: Bread and Cheese Bundle
description:
Coarse bread and a firm cheese wedge are wrapped together for one road meal. The bundle is easier to carry than a served board and includes no drink.

Sold as one wrapped bread-and-cheese meal. Weight includes light disposable wrapping or tying where needed; reusable bags, vessels and drinking water are separate. Partial use is tracked manually.

weight.notes: Adjusted total for one wrapped bread-and-cheese meal, including light wrapping or tying where applicable. Excludes reusable containers and water.
